data.title: Synthetic example: a verified offload procedure
data.summary: Illustrative scenario only; no actual occurrence asserted. A worker checks cloud bytes, unchanged sources and restoration before declaring an archive recoverable.
data.claim_ceiling: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY. Evidence is the public workflow document, not an operational receipt. IDs and times are illustrative; no real recovery, private evidence access or consumer use is asserted.
data.strongest_falsifier: This example provides no evidence that any real system executed the procedure.
data.ablation_failure: Proposed test only: remove byte verification and introduce a corrupted fixture; an independent checker should reject the result.
data.guard_or_mechanism: Bounded reviewed backup verification, source consistency checks, measured physical recovery and restoration test.
